WITH lab_patient AS (
  SELECT l.ID, l.PT, l.ALB, l.TP, p.SEX
  FROM Laboratory l
  INNER JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ID,
    SEX,
    AVG(PT) as avg_pt,
    AVG(ALB - TP) as avg_alb_minus_tp
  FROM lab_patient
  GROUP BY ID, SEX
),
overall_pt_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pt) as val
  FROM group_stats
  WHERE avg_pt IS NOT NULL
),
final_calcs AS (
  SELECT 
    gs.SEX,
    gs.avg_pt,
    gs.avg_alb_minus_tp,
    gs.avg_pt - opa.val as pt_diff
  FROM group_stats gs
  CROSS JOIN overall_pt_avg opa
  WHERE opa.val IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  SEX,
  AVG(avg_pt) as avg_group_pt,
  AVG(avg_alb_minus_tp) as avg_group_alb_minus_tp,
  AVG(pt_diff) as avg_pt_diff
FROM final_calcs
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY SEX
